summary: Loop that calls F_10FloatStructInitializer on a table of 256 elements starting at global unk_8BF740, advancing 26 DWORDs (104 bytes) per step, then returns the last initializer result.

operations.description: v0 initialized to the base of the float-struct table at global unk_8BF740.
v1 initialized to 256, the iteration count for the loop.
Do-while loop running exactly 256 times; each pass advances the table pointer by 26 DWORDs before the next call.
F_10FloatStructInitializer invoked with the current table pointer v0 to initialize the struct at that position.
v0 incremented by 26 DWORDs (104 bytes), moving to the next table element.
v1 decremented each iteration; loop repeats while v1 is non-zero.
Returns the result of the final F_10FloatStructInitializer call.

unresolved: Purpose of the 256-entry table at unk_8BF740 is unknown; it is only ever passed to F_10FloatStructInitializer here.
Significance of the 26-DWORD stride between table entries is unknown.
